title: DagPipe Premium Pipeline Generator
description: Describe your automation in plain English and automatically receive a robust, crash-proof DagPipe Python workflow.

description.title: Pipeline Description
description.description:
Provide a clear, plain-English description of what you want your pipeline to do.

**Example:** *'I need a pipeline that reads a tech blog post URL, summarizes the key points, attempts to translate the summary into Spanish, and saves both to a JSON file.'*
description.prefill: I want a pipeline that takes a URL, extracts the main article, analyzes sentiment, and outputs a structured JSON report.

groq_api_key.title: Groq API Key (Secure)
groq_api_key.description: Your free Groq API key to power the ultra-fast generation engine. This key is **never saved** and is securely injected only during execution.
